notes.title: Axe Ghost 1.1 - Fragments Update
notes.content:
Axe Ghost 1.1 adds Fragments mode; A collection of 21 puzzles created by Richard Boeser (ibb & obb, Dubio). You get one hand of cards, and a starting pattern of monsters that needs rearranging to achieve the objective. Complete the Fragments in any order you like. They start off gentle but get pretty challenging. I've forgotten how to complete Curtains. See if you can figure it out! 

Oh yeah: If you’ve played Axe Ghost, consider leaving a review (positive or negative). It's currently sitting at seven reviews from buyers. If it gets to ten that helps bring it to the attention of others who'd enjoy it! notes.title: Hotfix. June 4.
notes.content:
Fixes a bug where the Path to Readiness training stages wouldn't show up after completing the tutorial. If you played yesterday and didn't see Path to Readiness training stages you can use the Training slider on the settings page to play them.

This update also adds various tooltips.

notes.title: Update notes. June 3.
notes.content:
Changed the Timer description to clarify that you can continue your run after the timer reaches zero. Ignore the timer while you're getting used to the game!

Scalpel mechanic has been simplified. See description in-game.

Coin cooldown removed; you can use multiple coins in the same turn.

notes.title: Recent Updates #4
notes.content:
Added

 Leaderboard indicator shows whether this was the player's first attempt.
 Displace weapon.
 All Time leaderboard.
 Void weapon.

Changed

 Ice visual effect.
 Various sound effects.
 Daily Challenge can be played more than once.
 Displace can no longer push enemies off the edge of the grid.
 Switch now treats Bosses as wildcards when detecting contiguous groups of monsters (unless targeting the boss directly).
 Path to readiness dialogue animations.
 Leaderboard restyling. All Time leaderboard includes icons indicating special weapons for the run.
 Monsters advance one cell less far at the start of a run.

Fixed

 Tooltip/Switch interaction bug.
 Inconsistency with L-Push and groups containing a boss.
 Leaderboard caching bug.
 Leaderboard bugs, Death flash.
 Bug with weapon distribution. Should be less difficult again now.
 Rout threshold check only uses visible cells now.

notes.title: Recent Updates #3
notes.content:
Added


 Conversations with guide character if Path to Readiness is difficult.
 Scalpel weapon.
 Smite weapon.
 A sound effect plays when an enemy is on the last row.
 Icons in leaderboards to indicate which quest was the last completed in the run.


Fixed

 Game will now launch without internet connection, and the offline play modes (all but the Daily Challenge) will be available.
 Path to Readiness progress bug on the Settings page.
 Bug where a Rout would not clear weapon selection.
 Path to readiness game over bug.
 Quests/Routs interaction bug.
 Daily challenge button not locking bug.
 Bug where weapon selected before ending previous turn could be played in current turn.
 Faster game exit.


Changed

 Robot death rays no longer harm the ghost. 
 Path to Readiness condensed to 3 stages.
 Weapon selection algorithm is now sensitive to battlefield situation, should mean fewer useless weapons get served.
 Shears weapon removed.
 Mirror weapon removed.

notes.title: Recent Changes #2
notes.content:
Added

 Tusskra is the new boss of the first three Path to Readiness levels.
 Path to Readiness progress can be modified via the Settings screen.
 Box weapon.


Fixed

 Quests sometimes got interrupted by Routs.
 Daily run score submission retries up to ten times if there's a failure.
 Fixed: Played coins would interfere with quest completion.


Changed

 Switch weapon can now be used to swap Bosses with isolated monsters.
 Rout cooldown removed. Routs can now be caused on consecutive turns.
 Higher master audio level is possible in settings.
 Lots of graphics changes.

notes.title: Recent changes #1
notes.content:
Added

 Two new environments.
 Tutorial improvements.
 Path to Readiness for more gentle progression.


Fixed

 Grid bug in cave environment.
 Quest trigger bug.
 Tutorial advance bug.
 Bug where quickly abandoning a new game would mess things up.
 Coin number label bug.
 Coin remained grey bug.
 Spam 'End turn' button after killing boss bug.


Changed

 Less waiting around during Rout animations.
 Hovering over enemies with the Axe shows an indicator if a rout will happen.
 And a rout immediately ends the turn.
 Cards discarded because of a rout do not trigger quest failure.
 You can select the next weapon while the previous attack is still playing.
